claim_scope: Claude Sonnet 5 on the 30-task EnterpriseBench markdown-report confirmatory population remaining after the disclosed v1-v3 and v5 operational attempts

primary_estimands.name: mean_paired_reward_difference_mcp_only_minus_baseline
primary_estimands.aggregation: unweighted mean across all 30 paired tasks

primary_estimands.name: mean_paired_reward_difference_cli_minus_baseline
primary_estimands.aggregation: unweighted mean across all 30 paired tasks

descriptive_only.reason: the arms jointly change interface and local-source availability

inference.stratification: task_type with locked observed stratum sizes
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction at familywise alpha 0.05 for the two primary contrasts

reward_parity_gate_for_efficiency_claims.method: two one-sided tests using a 90% paired-bootstrap interval
reward_parity_gate_for_efficiency_claims.claim_rule: claim cheaper or faster at parity only when the complete 90% reward-difference interval is within [-0.05, 0.05]

missing_invalid_handling.incomplete_pair: no headline promotion or confirmatory inference
missing_invalid_handling.all_attempts: retain status, tokens, elapsed time, and cost

protocol_amendment.reason: v5 stopped fail-closed on a Sourcegraph MCP authentication failure before agent startup on the fourth attempt
protocol_amendment.selection_rule: exclude every task with v1-v3 or v5 agent output; retain all other locked candidates without inspecting reward
protocol_amendment.predecessor_analysis_use: operational evidence and task-level descriptive diagnostics only
